ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Provider Revalidation Process
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Medicaid provider revalidation process, including the criticism from providers and politicians.
questions: What are the concerns with the revalidation process?
How can the process be improved to prevent fraud and abuse?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant issues with the revalidation process, and could lead to changes in the system to prevent fraud and abuse.
